items.quote: Direct reports said that Ashavi Fenira delivered her share of change management after the merger of two units reliably.
Peers observed that Ashavi took ownership of capability building for new hires and steered it to completion.
Peers observed that Ashavi drove mapping interdependencies across agencies for the whole division.
Peers observed that Ashavi Fenira led the migration of core services to the cloud across the department.
Peers observed that Ashavi contributed effectively to evidence-based evaluation of programme outcomes.
